name: peoplecraft-site
description: PeopleCraft: the free HR library for India. Guides, templates, calculators and a glossary.

scripts.build: astro build && pagefind --site dist --output-subdir pagefind && node scripts/csp-meta.mjs dist
scripts.test: node --test src/lib/calc/*.test.ts src/lib/analytics/*.test.ts src/lib/orgchart/*.test.ts src/lib/mailmerge/*.test.ts src/lib/survey/*.test.ts src/lib/ics/*.test.ts src/lib/increment/*.test.ts src/lib/talent/*.test.ts src/lib/*.test.ts src/scripts/*.test.ts
